candidate_decisions.reason: The exact pericope trace connects the focus adverb to counted years in 18:11, awakening, measured stay, and an endpoint in 18:12. Those contacts materially change the warning into a bounded-suspension versus unbounded-loss contrast while preserving the emphatic temporal reading; the legacy-unbound source remains explicitly qualified.

The supplied 18:14 and 18:16 sequence gives inner stabilization, public standing, worship separation, and refuge before the focus threatens forced return. The trace therefore changes return into reversal of a completed secession without resolving the live alternative of outward conformity with inward conviction.

The exact 18:19 mission instructions place money, city entry, discreet conduct, and suppressed awareness immediately before the focus conditional. They supply a concrete leak-to-capture mechanism and retain the alternative that the details are only narrative setting; all attributed trace roles remain visible.

The focus warning is followed immediately by 18:21's purposeful finding, knowledge, promise, and truth. This creates a specific agency-and-purpose reversal in the meaning of exposure while retaining the live alternative that the later disclosure does not revise the original danger.

The focus's bodily threat is explicitly preserved, while 18:22 repeats the same root in rajman bil-ghayb and supplies hiddenness as the field for unsupported claims. The secondary discursive afterlife is contained beneath the physical reading and remains exploratory because the source is legacy-unbound.

findings.title: Bounded suspension and unbounded loss
findings.claim: The final promise of never succeeding becomes an unbounded counterterm to the companions' counted and ended suspension: preservation returns them to agency, whereas coerced return closes the horizon of flourishing permanently.
findings.mechanism: The focus adverb carries endpoint-free duration, while the supplied sequence names numbered years, awakening, a measured stay, and an endpoint. Their contact changes the final negation from emphasis alone into a contrast between reversible suspension and irreversible loss, without displacing the ordinary warning.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive why the warning reaches beyond immediate persecution: forced return would terminate the future opened by the cave's measured preservation.
findings.containment: The focus remains a warning that coercion leads to failure forever. The bounded-suspension contrast is an attributed macro resonance, not a claim that the temporal adverb loses its emphatic idiomatic force; the packet's alternative is that the contrast is not deliberate.

epistemic.reason: The exact 18:11, 18:12, and 18:20 anchors and complete trace support the relation, but the assigned HFT source is legacy-unbound and its contextual morphology is not independently supplied in the packet.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Sonu belirlenmeyen, çok uzun veya kesintisiz bir zaman süresini bildirir.
branch_activations.carrier: The final abadan carries endpoint-free duration in the focus warning.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Counted years, awakening, a measured stay, and an endpoint establish a bounded temporal field in the preceding pericope.
branch_activations.activation: The focus duration contacts the preceding measured and reversible suspension, making the threatened loss legible as the unbounded opposite of that preservation.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Never succeeding closes the future without endpoint after a sleep that had been counted, measured, and ended by awakening.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not replace the ordinary emphatic forever reading or assert that every temporal contrast is intentional.

branch_activations.carrier: The HFT-attributed endpoint occurrence in 18:12 supplies a limit against which the focus duration is measured.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus's endpoint-free abadan supplies the contrasting unlimited side.
branch_activations.activation: The attributed endpoint contacts the focus duration as its explicit temporal boundary, sharpening the change from measured stay to no-endpoint consequence.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The earlier stay has a limit; the threatened failure is described as having none.
branch_activations.boundary: This is attributed contextual evidence only; no independent lexical branch gloss is supplied for the endpoint root.

branch_activations.carrier: The HFT-attributed awakening occurrence in 18:12 carries an exit from stillness.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus's final temporal negation projects an unbounded consequence.
branch_activations.activation: Awakening gives the preceding suspension a real exit, allowing the focus's unbounded failure to register as a different kind of duration rather than another sleep interval.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Preserving the youths can end in renewed agency, while coerced return is framed as a future with no successful exit.
branch_activations.boundary: The trace does not establish a general doctrine about sleep; it concerns this supplied pericope sequence.

branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus adverb states duration without an endpoint.
branch_activations.activation: Determinate counting contacts the final unbounded duration as its contrasting temporal measure, making the warning's permanence newly dimensional.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The cave's time is countable and therefore bounded in principle; the threatened failure is not.
branch_activations.boundary: The packet's HFT trace is retained as contextual evidence and is not used as a lexical claim about the focus form yuʿidukum.

branch_activations.carrier: The HFT-attributed tarrying occurrence in 18:12 supplies the bounded state whose duration is assessed.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus adverb seals the negated outcome with no endpoint.
branch_activations.activation: A stay that can be assessed contacts a duration that cannot be brought to an endpoint, making the future loss more than a repeat of the cave's temporary concealment.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The companions' hidden stay is a bounded preservation; coerced return would make flourishing permanently unavailable.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not claim that the focus explicitly names the cave's duration or that the contextual inference is independently lexical.

findings.title: Forced return as reversed secession
findings.claim: The threatened return is not only a change of location or label: it would reverse the companions' completed secession, reinsert them into the worship and social order they had publicly left.
findings.mechanism: The focus causative return contacts the preceding sequence of hearts being fastened, public standing and declaration, withdrawal from the people's worship, and refuge. The focus word for creed names the destination domain, so the warning reaches across the inner, public, and social layers of departure.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see why return is feared as loss of an enacted allegiance rather than merely a journey back to the town.
findings.containment: The ordinary reading remains that the people may return the youths to their creed and thereby destroy their prospect of success. The macro trace does not decide whether outward conformity would necessarily erase inward conviction; that alternative remains open.

epistemic.reason: The supplied 18:14, 18:16, and 18:20 anchors form a direct pericope sequence, while the HFT source and missing independent target morphology require attributed qualification.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Ayrılınan bir şeye geri gelme ve başlangıçtan sonra aynı işe yeniden yönelme çekirdektir.
branch_activations.carrier: The Form IV return verb carries an imposed return after departure.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The earlier sequence records inner fastening, public standing, worship separation, and withdrawal to refuge.
branch_activations.activation: The completed departure supplies the prior state that makes the focus return a reversal rather than a neutral movement.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The threatened return runs the companions' achieved exit backward.
branch_activations.boundary: The relation concerns the supplied secession sequence and does not decide the inward state of anyone compelled outwardly.

branch_activations.activation: The creed domain contacts the prior act of separation, turning return into reinsertion into a rejected order.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The danger is restoration to the very religious-social system from which the companions withdrew.
branch_activations.boundary: The packet supports a communal creed and life-order relation, not a claim about every practice or every member of that community.

branch_activations.activation: Inner fastening makes the threatened return legible as undoing an already stabilized commitment, not simply relocating the youths.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Coercion would have to press against a formed inner resolve as well as the outward departure.
branch_activations.boundary: This is attributed evidence for the sequence and does not claim coercion necessarily changes inner belief.

branch_activations.carrier: The HFT-attributed rising with resolve supplies the public enactment of separation.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus return and creed destination threaten to reverse that enacted break.
branch_activations.activation: A public standing and declaration give the later return a visible reversal structure.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The threatened restoration would cancel a publicly performed refusal, not only an unspoken preference.
branch_activations.boundary: The trace does not establish that public action exhausts the companions' allegiance.

branch_activations.carrier: The HFT-attributed withdrawal to a side completes the social and spatial departure.

branch_activations.activation: Completed withdrawal supplies the spatial and social state that forced return would undo.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The threat sends the youths back across a boundary they had deliberately crossed.
branch_activations.boundary: The relation is limited to the supplied departure and return; it does not generalize to all forms of isolation.

branch_activations.carrier: The HFT-attributed worship occurrence identifies the practice from which the youths withdrew.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus creed destination makes that former practice the threatened site of restoration.
branch_activations.activation: The worship practice contacts the return verb and creed noun, making the coercion a reversal of religious separation.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Return would place the companions back inside the worship order they had refused.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not claim that the focus supplies a complete account of the community's worship.

findings.title: The leak-to-capture cascade
findings.claim: The focus conditional names the failure state of the covert provisioning operation: money must enter a city through discreet conduct, but recognition can become control and expose the whole group to persecution or forced reconditioning.
findings.mechanism: The 18:19 instructions join a visible token, a dense social setting, low-visibility conduct, and the suppression of awareness. Their contact with the focus exposure-over-you construction turns discovery into an operational leak that escalates into capture and the coercive fork.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive the warning as a threat model attached to an immediate mission, not as an unrelated hypothetical appended after the instructions.
findings.containment: The ordinary reading remains that discovery may lead to stoning or forced return. The operational cascade is attributed contextual evidence, and the packet retains the alternative that 18:19 is narrative setting rather than a deliberately specified causal chain.

epistemic.reason: The exact 18:19 and 18:20 anchors and the direct preceding command supply the contact, but the HFT source is legacy-unbound and its context-side morphology is not independently supplied.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Özne daha önce bilmediği veya erişemediği bir bilgiye ulaşır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus exposure verb can carry the discovery edge of information becoming available to the surrounding people.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The mission sends an observable token into the city while requiring discreet conduct and no awareness of the group.
branch_activations.activation: The suppression of awareness contacts the focus exposure construction as the feared information breach.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Discovery is the first failure in a covert operation whose identity has been kept from public knowledge.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch is used in the supplied over/upon context and does not replace the focus's ordinary manifestness or dominance range.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Güç ilişkilerinde karşı tarafı yenerek onun üzerinde üstünlük ve denetim kurmayı anlatır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus over/upon construction carries an exposure that can place the hostile group in a position of control.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The city, discreet movement, and suppressed awareness define the social conditions under which recognition can become domination.
branch_activations.activation: The operational breach contacts the focus's dominance edge, explaining why being found immediately opens the threat of stoning or forced return.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Recognition escalates into the captors' control over the youths and their future.
branch_activations.boundary: The packet does not claim that every instance of appearing over another is capture; this activation is restricted to the supplied mission sequence.

branch_activations.carrier: The HFT-attributed silver money is the observable token that must cross into circulation.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus names what follows if the group's exposure is discovered.
branch_activations.activation: A traceable token creates the material contact through which a hidden agent can be recognized.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The necessary purchase carries the possibility of exposing the people it is meant to sustain.
branch_activations.boundary: No claim is made that the packet proves the money was in fact traced by townspeople.

branch_activations.carrier: The HFT-attributed city supplies the dense social field in which the agent and token can be recognized.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus conditional turns recognition into a threat of hostile control.
branch_activations.activation: The city contact makes the focus's feared discovery socially concrete rather than abstract.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Entering the city places the hidden group within the very field where exposure can spread.
branch_activations.boundary: The city is treated as the supplied social setting, not as proof that every inhabitant participates in the threat.

branch_activations.carrier: The HFT-attributed fine and hidden mode supplies the required low-visibility conduct.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus exposure construction identifies the consequence if concealment fails.
branch_activations.activation: Discreet conduct contacts the focus by defining the concealment whose breach is feared.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The warning is attached to the fragility of careful concealment, not merely to chance encounter.
branch_activations.boundary: The trace does not claim that subtle conduct guarantees safety.

branch_activations.carrier: The HFT-attributed awareness term supplies the perception that must not be triggered in anyone.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus makes exposure the condition for the hostile alternatives.
branch_activations.activation: Suppressed awareness contacts the focus discovery branch as the exact information state the mission is designed to prevent.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Once awareness is triggered, the group's concealment can become persecution or coerced reinsertion.
branch_activations.boundary: This is a contextual threat model, not a claim that the focus word alone describes the entire mission procedure.

findings.title: When exposure becomes disclosure
findings.claim: The warning makes hostile discovery a failure, yet the next ayah shows that discovery itself can be retimed and repurposed: what would expose the youths to coercion can also make concealed truth knowable.
findings.mechanism: The focus exposure contact is followed by a caused finding in 18:21, a purpose clause of knowing, and confirmation of a promise as true. The change comes from agency and purpose, not from denying the danger named in 18:20.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can hold danger and disclosure together: visibility is not intrinsically one outcome when the agent, timing, and purpose change.
findings.containment: The focus warning remains fully intact for hostile discovery. The later ayah supplies a separate providential disclosure, and the packet retains the alternative that its later timing does not revise the original warning.

epistemic.reason: The adjacent 18:20 and 18:21 Arabic anchors and explicit purpose clause ground a concrete reversal, but the HFT source is legacy-unbound and the target-side morphology is not independently supplied.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Özne daha önce bilmediği veya erişemediği bir bilgiye ulaşır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus exposure verb carries the discovery event whose outcome is left open in the conditional warning.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The next ayah supplies purposeful finding, public knowledge, a promise, and truth fixed to reality.
branch_activations.activation: The purpose and agency of the later finding contact the focus discovery edge and change exposure from a single inevitable defeat into a differentiated event.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Hostile discovery can destroy agency, while a later purposeful disclosure can turn visibility into evidence.
branch_activations.boundary: The later disclosure does not cancel the focus's warning about hostile discovery and is not claimed to make all exposure beneficial.

branch_activations.carrier: The HFT-attributed coming upon what was hidden supplies the later disclosure event.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus names discovery as the condition for coercive harm.
branch_activations.activation: The later finding contacts the same focus exposure event with a changed agent and purpose.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Being found can be a hostile breach in one frame and a purposeful disclosure in another.
branch_activations.boundary: The trace does not collapse the two agents or claim that their consequences are interchangeable.

branch_activations.carrier: The HFT-attributed knowledge occurrences supply the public cognitive result of the later finding.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus exposure warning supplies the danger from which this result differs.
branch_activations.activation: Knowledge after finding contacts the focus's feared exposure and supplies the changed reader outcome.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Visibility can become a route by which what was hidden is understood rather than merely seized.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not claim that knowledge removes the youths' vulnerability in the original warning.

branch_activations.carrier: The HFT-attributed promise supplies the proposition that the later disclosure is made to confirm.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus exposure verb supplies the earlier danger of being found by hostile people.
branch_activations.activation: Promise-purpose contacts exposure, changing the later finding from mere loss of concealment into evidentiary disclosure.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: A concealed group's visibility can serve the confirmation of a promise under a different agency and purpose.
branch_activations.boundary: The packet does not claim that the promise explains every consequence of the focus conditional.

branch_activations.carrier: The HFT-attributed truth occurrence supplies the evidentiary status produced by the later disclosure.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus describes exposure as a route to hostile coercion.
branch_activations.activation: Truth fixed to reality contacts the focus exposure event and supplies a distinct public result for purposeful finding.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The same visibility that can expose people to power can, under the next ayah's purpose, establish what is true.
branch_activations.boundary: Truth-confirmation is attributed to the next ayah's disclosure and does not convert the hostile conditional into a positive promise.

findings.title: From bodily stoning to verbal casting
findings.claim: The focus's literal threat remains bodily, while the same root later gives exposure a secondary discursive afterlife: hidden people can be pelted with unsupported conjecture as well as endangered by stones.
findings.mechanism: The focus root carries the material threat and an injurious-speech edge; 18:22 repeats it in rajman bil-ghayb beside the hiddenness term. The later recurrence contacts the focus without replacing its physical force, producing a contained double vulnerability.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see how physical danger and the social violence of unsupported claims share a root image while remaining distinct acts.
findings.containment: Physical stoning is primary in 18:20. The conjectural and verbal readings are secondary macro resonances grounded in 18:22, marked exploratory, and do not claim that the focus itself means public speculation.

epistemic.reason: The exact root recurrence and hiddenness contact are supplied, and the support explicitly contains the physical reading, but the attributed HFT source is legacy-unbound and labels the secondary connection exploratory.

branch_activations.carrier: The focus stoning verb preserves the material stone force of the threat.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The later root recurrence names conjectural casting beside the hiddenness of the group.
branch_activations.activation: The later recurrence keeps the root's concrete stone field present while opening a distinct verbal use.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The physical threat remains visible as the material ground beneath the later discursive extension.
branch_activations.boundary: The stone-pile facet is a contained root-image resonance, not a claim that the finite focus verb directly denotes a tomb or pile.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir kişiye ya da onun hakkında ağır, incitici ve hoşlanılmayan sözler söylemektir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus threat carries the root's injurious force against the youths.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The later occurrence turns the same root toward speech cast about what is hidden and unknown.
branch_activations.activation: The material attack contacts the later verbal attack through the shared root image, while the hiddenness trigger keeps the acts distinct.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Exposure can endanger bodies directly and can also expose the hidden group to injurious public speech.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus is not retranslated as verbal abuse; this is a secondary social mode retained beneath the physical threat.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bilgi sahibi olmadan bilinmeyen bir konu hakkında kesinliksiz söz söylemektir.
branch_activations.carrier: The later rajman occurrence carries unsupported speech about the hidden group.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus uses the same root in a concrete conditional threat against the youths.
branch_activations.activation: The later conjectural use returns through the focus root and changes the afterlife of exposure from bodily vulnerability to epistemic and social vulnerability.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The concealed group can be harmed by claims made without knowledge as well as by physical attack.
branch_activations.boundary: No claim is made that the focus conditional itself asserts conjecture or that every later statement about the group is baseless.

branch_activations.carrier: The HFT-attributed hiddenness occurrence supplies the epistemic absence into which later claims are cast.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The repeated root supplies the casting image and the focus supplies its bodily threat.
branch_activations.activation: Hiddenness makes conjectural casting possible as a distinct consequence of exposure, returning the later claim to the focus's vulnerable concealed group.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: What is hidden can be attacked through unsupported speech even when the physical threat is not being enacted.
branch_activations.boundary: This is attributed contextual evidence and does not treat hiddenness as proof that the later speakers are wrong in every detail.

friction_notes: All five supplied HFT records are exact declared-pericope records with complete anchor coverage, but their legacy-unbound provenance keeps the retained findings qualified or exploratory and leaves each supplied live alternative visible in containment.
The explicit 1:2-1:7 external overlay was quarantined during Phase 1 and adds no direct focus-root carrier or trigger in Phase 2, so no external overlay finding was retained.

The D_BOUNDED_STASIS count trace is retained as attributed contextual evidence at 18:11:7. The packet's root_000989/B001 registry record is a focus-side record with a conflicting focus occurrence, so it is not used as a lexical claim about يُعِيدُ.
No uncandidate secondary branch had an independent macro trigger beyond the primary floor; available branches without such contact remain unactivated without an exhaustive negative inventory.
